data.name: Khuzaimah
data.gender_notes: Khuzaimah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khaiz' meaning warrior, this name is a beautiful reminder of the spiritual battle each Muslim must wage against their own inner weaknesses and temptations. The name Khuzaimah carries the meaning “Young warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khuzaimah usually hope their child will grow to embody young warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Strive for righteousness in the face of adversity
data.etymology: Khuzaimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khuzaimah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Khuzaimah
in_english.meaning: Khuzaimah means stability, strength, and patience
in_english.long_meaning: Khuzaimah is a masculine Arabic name that signifies stability, strength, and patience. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'kh-z-m', Khuzaimah conveys the idea of being steadfast and resilient. Historically, Khuzaimah is associated with companions of the Prophet Muhammad, reflecting its significance in Islamic tradition. The name embodies qualities of determination and fortitude, making it a meaningful choice for Muslim parents seeking a name with spiritual and cultural depth

historical_references.context: Khuzaimah ibn Thabit was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and one of the Ten Promised Paradise. He took part in several battles and was known for his bravery and religious knowledge.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani, Al-Isaba, Volume 2, p. 775 The name Khuzaimah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Khuzaimah ibn Thabit was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and was known for his knowledge of the Quran and Hadith. He was also a prominent leader in the Battle of Uhud and played a significant role in the defense of Madinah.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Khuzaimah is of Islamic origin and is derived from the Arabic language. It is a name given to a prominent figure in Islamic history, Khuzaimah ibn Thabit, who was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and played a significant role in early Islamic history. Today, Khuzaimah is a topic of interest among scholars and researchers in the fields of Islamic history, religious studies, and Middle Eastern culture. His life and contributions are studied extensively on academic platforms such as Academia.edu, Google Scholar, and ResearchGate. These platforms provide access to a wealth of information and resources related to Khuzaimah, including scholarly articles, research papers, and books. The modern context of Khuzaimah's name is therefore closely associated with academic research and study in the fields mentioned above.
